Subject: Your tenancy eviction matter - R.C.S. No. 2642/2021

Dear Mr. Bhosale,

Thank you for meeting us on 15 June 2021 about your dispute with Charulata Sen. As we understand it, the landlord is trying to evict the tenant after a rent increase was refused.

Our advice is to deposit the admitted rent in court to avoid an order striking off the defence. Please collect all rent receipts and the bank record of the rent deposited in court and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹4,65,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
